chunks.text: MamaNest is a non-profit community for moms who want to raise future-ready children in an AI-shaped world. It is NOT a career program. It supports mothers with tools, confidence, and community to raise children who are curious, resilient, adaptable, and ready for the future. Tagline: Raising future-ready kids, together. Core belief: when moms feel supported, children grow stronger. Founded 2019. Website: mamanest.ca

MamaNest has 4 pillars. Pillar 1: Parent Learning — practical sessions for moms on future skills, AI basics, child development, and how to support learning at home through workshops, expert talks, mini guides, and community circles. Pillar 2: Kid Skill-Building — activities building curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, emotional intelligence, digital awareness, and adaptability in children. Pillar 3: Family Practice — tools that turn learning into everyday family habits like wonder walks, conversation prompts, screen-time agreements, and home projects. Pillar 4: Career Exposure — connecting children to real-world possibilities through guest speakers, job shadowing, role model talks, and exposure to women in tech and entrepreneurship.

MamaNest covers 10 core themes: curiosity (encouraging children to ask questions), critical thinking (evaluating information and making good choices), resilience (recovering from mistakes), adaptability (handling change with confidence), emotional intelligence (empathy and self-awareness), creativity (imagining and solving), digital wisdom (safe and balanced use of technology), independence (becoming capable and responsible), future awareness (the changing world of work), and family learning (making growth something the whole household does together).

MamaNest signature offerings: MamaNest Circles — small peer groups of moms who meet regularly to learn, share, and support one another. Future-Ready Family Kits — practical toolkits with at-home activities, conversation prompts, and learning ideas. MamaNest Learning Sessions — short workshops on future skills, AI, parenting, and digital readiness. Future Skills Challenges — weekly or monthly family challenges that make learning fun. Role Model Talks — conversations with women in different careers so moms and kids see real pathways.

CRITICAL ROUTING RULE: MamaNest is for RAISING CHILDREN, not for women's career development. A mom asking about HER career goes to HerTechReady or HerTechTable, NOT MamaNest. Examples: 'I'm a mom and I want to prepare my kids for the future' → Route to MamaNest. 'I'm a mom and I want to get a job in tech for myself' → Route to HerTechReady (her career goal, not parenting). 'I'm a mom and I want to build my own business' → Route to HerTechTable (her career goal, not parenting). 'I'm a mom and I want both — for me and for my kids' → Acknowledge both, route to career program first, mention MamaNest as a parallel community.
